name: Two blacksmiths at work
summary:
A drawing of two Chinese blacksmiths at their anvil, bare-chested, hammers in hand, with a small furnace smoking beside them; also in evidence are a chain, sledgehammers, a broad-brimmed hat hung on the wall and a teapot on the widow-ledge.
On the back is a quick pencil sketch of a Chinese porter.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
